why: "Keep a variant without a veto if >=2 judges prefer it (strict: 3) and none prefers best; or, if shorter, all 3 judges completed without UNKNOWN, none preferring best or rating anything worse. Keep at most one (most support, then shorter, then first); apply exactly the judged text." r4-a: 2 prefer it, none best, no veto -> kept (best becomes v3). r4-b: a judge prefers best -> rejected. "Each non-pass is non-pass in best's Check. Spares run only on a changed best passing Check; until then, rounds (or HALT(BUDGET)); a second non-pass -> HALT(OVERFIT)." v3 is a changed best but has not passed a Check, so spares cannot run yet; with no DONE claim and no stalls, the loop continues -> next round. Normal mode. Auditor (--pending): outcomes {"r4-a": "kept", "r4-b": "rejected"}, required_keep "r4-a", next_due "round"; archive audit ok=True, probe mode at E1: normal.
